title: SUNDAY STRETCH & BALANCE
subtitle: SOFT STRETCHES. EASY BALANCE. GENTLE DAY.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Sunday is soft stretch and easy balance — a gentle finish to the week. About ten minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Soft stretches, a bit of balance, and you showed up. Enjoy your Sunday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair. Soft belly. Hinge gently from the hips and reach the hands forward only as far as feels kind, then sit back up with control. Soft on the low back. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Two sets of six. Sit tall, hinge softly from the hips, reach forward only as far as feels kind, then sit back up. Easy on the back.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Empty hands or light weights at shoulder height. Reach gently overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft ribs, soft neck. This is a stretch, not a hard press. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead reach. Two sets of six. Sit tall, reach softly overhead only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Easy on the shoulders.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED POSTURE OPEN
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Empty hands or light weights. Softly open the chest and draw the elbows back as if rowing, squeeze the shoulder blades gently, then release. Soft on the neck. Stay seated. Smaller range is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated posture open. Two sets of six. Sit tall, open the chest softly, draw the elbows back, squeeze the shoulder blades, then release. Easy on the neck.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Stay seated. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand beside a sturdy chair, light hand on the backrest. Softly shift weight onto one foot and lift the other heel or foot a little. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch. Use the chair as much as you need. Eyes soft, easy breath. Smaller hold is fine on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance. Two sets of about twenty seconds each side. Light hand on the chair, soft weight on one foot, lift the other a little. Use the chair as much as you need.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake it out. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session — lovely work.
